principle_violations.reason: The Order class handles both order management and storage of order details (items, quantities, and prices). Each responsibility should have its own class or structure.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the order management and order detail storage responsibilities. Consider creating an OrderDetails class that handles item management.

principle_violations.reason: The concrete payment processors have direct dependencies on an authentication or security implementation (SMSAuthorizer), leading to high coupling.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce an interface for the authorizer that is used by payment processors, reducing direct reliance on the SMSAuthorizer class, and allowing different types of authorizers to be used interchangeably.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
